scripts.postinstall: mkdir -p /opt/render/.cache/chrome && cd /opt/render/.cache/chrome && curl -L -o chrome.zip 'https://www.googleapis.com/download/storage/v1/b/chromium-browser-snapshots/o/Linux_x64%2F1082391%2Fchrome-linux.zip?alt=media' && unzip -q chrome.zip && rm chrome.zip && chmod +x chrome-linux/chrome && ls -la /opt/render/.cache/chrome/ && find /opt/render/.cache/chrome -name '*chrome*' -type f
